verdict.rationale:
Vercel documents a dedicated Workflow SDK for durable, multi-step logic that retries, waits for external events, and resumes across crashes/deployments — the core of autonomous background automation — plus Vercel Agent taking 'approved actions' autonomously, Sandbox for isolated agent-generated code execution, webhooks for event-driven triggers, and scheduled ISR regeneration. These are first-party, well-documented capabilities specifically targeted at agentic/background workflows.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that Workflows or Agent actually run unattended in production over time, and clearer cron/scheduling documentation beyond ISR revalidation.
